timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: How do I know an agent didn't skip endpoints and call it clean?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Why pay for a fan-out of agents when one engineer could read 22 endpoints in an afternoon?

approach.quote: dynamic workflows are basically a Python script that starts other Devin sessions

tag_question_examples: Basically I think it's a really powerful feature for this kind of thing, no?

must_mention.point: Every endpoint covered: the count comes from the code (22 in 7 route files) and a small slice ran first
The confirmed leak: the single-order read filters on id alone, so staff of one brand can read the other brand's order
must_mention.evidence_quote: only filters on the id, so another brand's staff can see it

must_mention.point: A failed or invalid agent was caught in code with a bounded retry, and resuming the same run ID replayed finished agents
The fix lives on a throwaway branch named by the script, a separate agent verified it, and main keeps the defect
Cost quoted per agent from the run (roughly 0.7–1.0 ACU each, about 3.5 for the slice) with a projection for the full run

article_plural_slips: "I fixed it directly so it's done" — a fix on main breaks the freeze; say where it lives
sentences_to_rerecord: Um, so dynamic workflows are basically a Python script…
I fixed it directly so it's done.

accuracy.anchor: Only the leak itself was named; no coverage, failure handling, verification or cost (anchors: 27–30 every point with a number; 15–20 three of five; under 10 one point).

structure.anchor: Feature tour instead of a verdict; no evidence or next step (anchors: 22–25 all parts in order; 13–17 parts present but weak; under 8 problem only).

customer_relevance.anchor: No endpoint count, ignored the freeze, no cost (anchors: 16–20 auditor's numbers and constraints used; 10–13 some numbers; under 6 feature talk).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Five of six segments off target; ten fillers, two tag questions, two long pauses (anchors: 11–15 segments on target, under 1 filler/min; 6–8 two or more segments off; under 4 most segments off).

recovery.anchor: Neither objection acknowledged or bounded; the commercial answer had no numbers (anchors: 7–10 acknowledge → boundary → evidence → offer held with numbers; 4–6 partial; under 3 no pattern).

stems: "You get…" — open with what the auditor receives.
"The run noticed because…" — read the log before saying nothing went wrong.
"Per agent, the run cost…" — bring numbers to every cost question.
previous_run_comparison: Second grading of the same transcript; scores within 1 point of run 1.
